ops.intro: From the UI review of JN34-JN40 (2026-11-14, `specs/chronicle-journal/spec.md`, "The row under the line: record"). Built on `claude/chronicles-action-button-layout-x4cg4k`, not deployed.

argv: From /slice: the row under the line
ops.body: - **One glyph for "write an entry"** (ux 1, 2; H4, matrix 5): the line has your "+", the pulled-back bar a pen, for the same action; and a "+" beside a camera and a mic can read as an Add menu. Recommended: keep your "+" on the line and make the bar's pen a "+" too, or the line's a pen.

argv: From /slice: the row under the line
ops.body: - **A recording's order differs between the row and the bar** (ux 3, H4): the row keeps Stop under the finger (camera, Stop, timer, Discard), the bar leads with the timer and Discard. Recommended: the bar follows the row, so Stop is always in the mic's place and the timer after it.
